page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 4 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 30.0 GB of system memory, providing 7.5 GB per core, and includes a bundled local storage configuration of 472 GB SSD. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

The instance integrates a single NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. While synthetic CPU and memory benchmarks, such as stress-ng and PassMark, place the host processor and memory bandwidth in the lower performance tiers, the GPU acceleration delivers strong results for specific workloads. Notably, LLM inference benchmarks show top-tier performance for prompt processing with small and medium models, achieving 9863.53 tokens per second on a 135M model and 316.25 tokens per second on a 7B model.

Given the older Intel Xeon and NVIDIA Pascal hardware architecture, this instance represents a specialized option where GPU acceleration is required without the cost overhead of newer generation accelerators. The combination of dedicated CPU cores, local SSD storage, and dedicated VRAM makes it suitable for entry-level deep learning, LLM inference on smaller models, and GPU-assisted data processing tasks, though it is less optimal for CPU-heavy or high-memory-bandwidth database operations.
